acceptance_predicates.description: The persistent footer changes with the active element and exposes concise meaningful current help.
The overlay presents only actions legal in the active state, with stable key labels and categories.
Opening, navigating, and closing help preserves focus and uncommitted wizard state.
Every visible action and element resolves meaningful help; missing, stale, or orphaned help fails CI.

definition_of_done: Users can discover the current action, its purpose, and its hotkey without leaving the TUI.

outputs.description: Focus-aware footer and context-filtered hotkey overlay.

gates.description: CI verifies every model/inventory element and action has current meaningful footer and overlay help.
